text:
marie_sales: Heads-up: Sentinel Corp wants a week-long POC. CISO submitted a tightened identity checklist (SSO + SCIM + strict RBAC + domain lock). Need a quick presales runbook.

tony_se: I can pick this up. What's mandatory?

marie_sales: They require SAML (IdP + SP initiated), SCIM v2 with delta support and bulk import, explicit role attributes on groups, delegated tenant admin tokens, domain-locked provisioning, and ability to forward audit logs to their SIEM during POC.

paul_sec: Security notes: BYOK required (customer KMS), HSM/FIPS mention for compliance, immutable audit trails and option for 180d retention. They also want an incident contact for the POC.

eva_pm: Product: Dedicated POC nodes ok. Default audit retention 90d; enterprise retention options 180/365 available as opt-in. SIEM forwarding supported via HTTP webhook or syslog. File upload domain verification acceptable for POC via support.

tony_se: SCIM details: we support /Users and /Groups and ChangeLog delta. Rate limits for POC: 1k ops/min; for >30k users we run async bulk import. Note: our RBAC engine currently does not auto-interpret a "role" SCIM attribute into tenant roles. Workarounds below.

marie_sales: Their IdP sends transient NameID; they want email as NameID. Can SSO mapping handle that?

tony_se: Yes, attribute transform in SSO config can map email -> NameID. I'll include screenshots. For role mapping, workaround: small lambda that listens to SCIM changes and calls our admin role-mapping API.

tony_se: Example POC curl snippet:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/role-mappings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"group":"sentinel-admins","role":"tenant_admin"}'

rachel_billing: Credits: we can cover up to 180k tokens/day for a 1-week POC. Anything above needs a short paid uplift. I'll draft a one-page SOW and trial terms.

paul_sec: For questionnaire: confirm KMS integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure), non-exportable keys, and rotation policies. We'll attach HSM attestation pack on request.

support_bot: domain_check: sentinel.example pending file_upload (ticket #9421). cert_status: pending.

eva_pm: Action items: Tony -> SSO + SCIM runbook with screenshot and mapping lambda sample; Rachel -> trial SOW/credits; Paul -> security Q responses + attestation docs; Marie -> confirm expected user count and peak tokens/day. I'll consolidate in the deal tracker and schedule a 30m preflight.

marie_sales: Sent to customer: please upload verification file to ticket #9421 and confirm expected user count (est ~15k) and peak tokens/day. Scheduling preflight for tomorrow 9:30am PT.

tony_se: I'll have the runbook ready by EOD PST.

rachel_billing: SOW draft incoming in 2 hours.

paul_sec: I'll assemble answers and attach attestation pack by EOD.

marie_sales: Great, thanks all. Short updates only in this thread.
